- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The ruling led to a series of legal battles and helped spark the Civil Rights Movement of the 1950s and 1960s.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Significant events that led to the Civil Rights Movement include:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. The Montgomery Bus Boycott (1955) was sparked by the arrest of Rosa Parks.

  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. The Greensboro Sit-ins (1960) were organized by four African-American college students to protest segregation at lunch counters.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. The March on Washington (1963) drew over 250,000 people and featured Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.'s "I Have a Dream" speech.
